20. Architecture vs design pattern

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Architecture describes major system structures, boundaries and quality tradeoffs; a design
pattern solves a recurring design problem at an appropriate scope.
සිංහJලෙන් Architecture එJකන් system එJක් Jලාකු structure සහ boundaries තීරණය කරනවා. Design
pattern එJකන් නුවත එන design problem එකකට විසඳුමක් ලබාJදනවා.
A layered monolith is the architecture; Strategy inside its payment module is a pattern.

System architecture / Layered monolith · Module / Checkout · Pattern Payment Strategy · Read the diagram: The inner design decision lives inside the broader system structure. · කුඩා design එක system structure එක ඇතුJළේ තිJයනවා.

Architecture decision: one deployable application.
Design decision: Payment interface with interchangeable implementations.
Expected result: The deployment decision and object design decision operate at different scales.

Q: Can patterns appear inside architectures?
A: Yes. They can help implement particular architectural responsibilities.
